narrative.intro: Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System has $405M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System has 13 awards so far this fiscal year, and the average award size is $31.2M. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations are up 6.3% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a steady upward pattern: FY21 totaled $254M, FY22 totaled $253M, FY23 totaled $293M, FY24 totaled $342M, FY25 totaled $381M, and FY26 totaled $405M. The current-year totals are partial because the period reported is FY2026 to date. The note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Use these figures to compare scale and momentum across years and to benchmark average award size against total obligations when evaluating program-level participation.

sections.heading: How have Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations changed over recent years?
sections.body: Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations rose from $254M in FY21 to $405M in FY26. Fedex Supply Chain Distribution System obligations were $253M in FY22, $293M in FY23, $342M in FY24, and $381M in FY25.
